description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From – A
New in the Original Packaging
What is this Part?
This is the #1 & #2 Parking Brake Cables for the Suzuki Samurai
The #1 cable goes from the Hand Brake Lever to the Rear Brake Drum.
The #2 cable goes from the Driver’s Side Rear Brake Lever Assembly to the Passenger’s Side Rear Brake Lever Assembly
Direct Replacement
Note: We also carry the Asian/European Right Hand Drive Cable (slightly longer)
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Parking Brake Cable #1
Qty 1 – Parking Brake Cable #2
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
